rows.quote: The blood eQTL data were obtained from the eQTLGen1 and the Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx) project.2 Subsequently, summary data on AMD and its subtypes from the latest release (R10 version) of the FinnGen study were utilized as outcomes.
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the R10 version release of the FinnGen study.

rows.quote: The replication set for AMD data was obtained from the study by Winkler TW et al., comprising 14,034 cases and 91,234 controls.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: the study by Winkler TW et al.
